newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO tenders to buy 222,000/T Aug-Sept fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO tenders to buy 222,000/T Aug-Sept fuel oil.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Company (KEPCO) has issued a tender to buy three 74,000-tonne cargoes of 0.3-percent, 540-cst fuel oil for August and September deliveries, a KEPCO source said on Monday.
The first cargo will be for delivery August 13-17, the second for August 28 to September 1 and the last for September 18-22 to the port of Ulsan, the source said.
The tender will close on June 19 and offers will be valid for three days.
In its last fuel oil purchase, KEPCO bought two 70,000-tonne cargoes at $126.70 and $133.00 per tonne respectively on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
